t: Introduction and overview — America-class Amphibious Assault Ship
name: Introduction and overview — America-class Amphibious Assault Ship — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — America-class Amphibious Assault Ship
description: Introduction and overview of the America-class Amphibious Assault Ship: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The America class — two built, more planned — are 45,693-ton LHAs optimized for aviation: the first two ships omitted the well deck for larger aviation facilities to support F-35Bs and MV-22s. Later ships restore the well deck. America and Tripoli are the largest amphibious ships ever built for the U.S. Baseline facts: U.S. amphibious assault ship; 45,693 tons; aviation-optimized; F-35B/MV-22..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
